propositions: Rebar must resolve one immutable, serializable OperationSnapshot per operation with consistent precedence across CLI, MCP, Python, and reconciler paths without in-progress environment rereading.

Operation-local configuration and runtime bindings must compose subsystem-local GitRuntime, LLMRuntime, and BridgeRuntime without arbitrary client injection or second scheduler, preserving RP-01 budget/retry/cache/tracing behavior.

Static secrets must be represented only via provider-specific non-serializable Pydantic carriers, revealed solely in sending adapters, with zero credential leakage across repr/equality/serialization/logs/argv/subprocess siblings.

Op-cert must enforce exclusive startup sources (REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY), validate before service work, use process-owned 0700/0600 copies, and contain no runtime SSM/boto3/region dependency.

AST ownership gate must derive config/credential names from authoritative registries, reject direct/aliased ambient reads below approved seams, and reach zero legacy exceptions at cutover without universal secret brokers or cloud-secret retrieval.

Same-capability child processes must inherit ambient environment; owning children receive only their adapter overlay; unrelated siblings must lose exact Rebar-declared secret names without global os.environ mutation.
